relationships.subject: MFN2 R94Q
relationships.evidence_quote: MFN2R94Q/+ spinal motor neurons displayed impaired mitochondrial trafficking

relationships.subject: ACY-738
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, we showed that mitochondrial trafficking defects could be alleviated by treatment with an HDAC6 inhibitor.

relationships.subject: ACY-738
relationships.evidence_quote: We confirmed that the ACY-738 treatment increased the amount of acetylated α-tubulin in treated cells

key_findings: MFN2 R94Q spinal motor neurons show reduced mitochondrial motility; HDAC6 inhibition with ACY-738 restores it and rescues swimming in a zebrafish CMT2A model.
